name: Arigato Universe Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Arigato Universe Ltd is in the business of I.T. Services and manufacturing and dealing in construction related materials, and commodities[1]
keyPoints:

b) It does execution of contracts related to real estate and development of land, development of and dealing in immovable properties.
c) It also develops properties for Hospitality Recreational Activities and related services
